Impromptu Sneak Attack.description: Starting at 3rd level, an arcane trickster may designate one melee or ranged attack per day as a sneak attack (ranged attacks are limited to targets within 30 feet). The chosen target loses its Dexterity bonus to AC for that single attack only. This ability works against any creature, though targets immune to critical hits do not take the additional sneak attack damage (they still lose their Dexterity bonus to AC against the attack). At 7th level, this ability can be used twice per day.

Ranged Legerdemain.description: An arcane trickster gains the ability to use certain skills at a distance of 30 feet: Disable Device, Open Lock, or Sleight of Hand. Performing a skill remotely raises the DC of the check by 5, and the character may not take 10 on this roll. The targeted object must weigh no more than 5 pounds. This ability may be used once per day at 1st level, twice per day starting at 5th level, and three times per day from 9th level onward. Only a single ranged legerdemain check is permitted per day, and the character must possess at least 1 rank in the relevant skill.

Sneak Attack.description: This functions identically to the rogue class feature of the same name. The bonus damage increases by +1d6 at every even-numbered class level (2nd, 4th, 6th, 8th, and 10th). Sneak attack damage from this class stacks with sneak attack damage gained from any other source.

Spells per Day.description: Each time an arcane trickster gains a new class level, the character receives additional spells per day as though having also advanced one level in a spellcasting class to which they belonged prior to entering this prestige class. This does not confer any other benefits that the prior class would normally provide, aside from improved effective caster level. Characters who had multiple spellcasting classes before becoming an arcane trickster must choose which class receives the additional level for the purpose of spells per day.

Weapon and Armor Proficiency.description: Taking levels in this prestige class does not grant proficiency with any weapons or armor.
